root_rule: Each physical seat takes its first qualifying root on its first still-unused held map in ascending seed order. Both seats and all 4 eligible saved matches measured; no after-the-fact filtering. Only exact parent included.
first_turn: Between steps 100 and 199 redirect at most one distinct public parent movement to an empty safe adjacent cell. Own sampled history for at least half its four neighboring cells, estimated carbon total >=120, predicted first-tenure soil receipts minus current fee exceed the alternative parent's nonnegative predicted net by >10. Competitor model for learning the soil receipts predates these held maps. Do not cancel a current pay/seize or parent planned enemy-tree route; exclude ally current or intended occupancy. Joint budget reserves other recruits and purchases.
next_turn: Only if the same worker survived and arrived, independently has >=120 visible carbon on its four neighbors, remains safe, can afford the shared-order fee and has positive estimated soil net, request staying, even when parent intended to depart. All later joint commands come from original parent without further changes. Complete opponent reselects all commands after taped simultaneous root.
gate: Both targeted trees must result in an actual logged cash debit at t+1 in changed arm and be additional to parent focal site at t+1; in each, the target tree must earn more ground-only cash before original tenure ends than its actual debited price. Across the two roots, total own ground-only earnings less all plant fees must improve versus parent AND summed official terminal margin must improve. Full package matches both selected roots and next-move pass/abstain before independent map 621758337, subject to fresh registry/terrain clearance. Otherwise stop.
held_map_note: Two small, previously exposed development maps; information from rival commands, terminal scores, post-selection arrivals and hidden terrain is excluded at selection.
